package rulefixtures

import (
	"time"
)

// scenario for time_newtimer_inside_loop: `time.NewTimer(...)` inside loops.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.
func scenario683Positive(items []string) int {
	total := 0
	for _, item := range items {
		timer := time.NewTimer(50 * time.Millisecond)
		select {
		case <-timer.C:
			total += len(item)
		default:
		}
	}
	return total
}
